sections.h2: 1. Use the code on a bigger set
parts: The code takes {pct} off the whole order, so it saves most on the large sets: $13 on the Izakaya or the Game Stack, and $17 on the 2,507-piece Apartment. The lights come with the set: the Izakaya lists 20 light points and 8 light strips, the Game Stack 23 light points and 10 strips.

Its newsletter sign-up also offers 10% off; most stores take one code per order, so compare that with {code} at checkout.

sections.h2: 3. Order from the warehouse closest to you
parts: Lumibricks ships from warehouses in the US, Canada, Germany, the UK and China, and you pick your region on the product page. Shipping is free within the US, the UK, and to Germany, Czechia and Poland. Other EU countries pay $5.99 to $36, Canada $9.99, and Australia and the rest of the world pay what checkout shows, plus any import duties.

Lumibricks lists 3 to 5 business days from its US, Canada and UK warehouses, 3 to 6 within the EU, and 6 to 12 from China to Australia and other countries. It doesn't ship to PO boxes, APO addresses or parcel lockers.

You can return items within 30 days of delivery: outside the EU they must be unused, in original condition and packaging. EU buyers have a 14-day right of withdrawal. Submit the request through Lumibricks' form or email service@lumibricks.com; it says it replies within 2 business days and refunds within 5 to 10 business days after the item arrives. You pay return shipping unless the item is faulty or wrong.
